title: King Kragmaw
html:
King Kragmaw is a named Troll King seen at level 49.

Where to find King Kragmaw

  • Inside Kragmaw's Court · seen 3×

What it can drop

  • Kragmaw's Cleaver (unique Gold Longsword, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). A kill heals you for 4% of your maximum hitpoints.
  • Brandfletch (unique Black Walnut Longbow, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). 8% of hits set the target burning.
  • Ossk's Bonestaff (unique Black Walnut Staff, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). A kill restores 8% of your maximum mana. An attack or spell that kills several monsters restores it once.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
